scope: Bound const and move staging of the caller-supplied source-to-output DXF handle remap.

behavior: The const setter validates count before copying, stages into a temporary map and swaps only after successful allocation; copy failure clears stale mappings and marks the pending input rejected.
The rvalue setter validates before consuming input; over-limit input remains caller-owned while stale codec mappings are discarded.
A rejected remap blocks a new write before output creation. Replacing it with an in-limit map clears the rejection; an invalid remap attempted during an active write marks that attempt failed.
The existing GROUP-plan freeze and setup-phase checks retain their prior behavior.

normalFocused.coverage: Over-limit const and move refusal, exact-limit acceptance, caller preservation, stale-map clearing, corrected same-codec retry, and ASCII/Binary destination preservation after rejected remap setup.

limitations: The 100,000-entry ceiling is an internal resource limit, not a DXF format maximum or support claim.
The guard bounds map node count; it is not an allocator-capacity or RSS measurement.
Allocation failure during the const-map copy was not fault-injected in this slice.
A private dxfRW state field changed class layout; downstream consumers must rebuild, and ABI compatibility remains an open P8 gate.
Other unbounded setup inputs, including source BLOCK_RECORDs and canonical linetype metadata, remain in the P6 safety audit.
next: Continue the P6 safety audit on nested source BLOCK_RECORD and canonical linetype setup inputs.
